messages:
Maya Chen: Heads upCloudAlpha sent the co-branded solution brief for marketplace listing. Aim to publish Tues EOD. Need quick logo + quote check. Link: https://files.redwood.com/cloudalpha/solution-brief-v3.pdf

Kevin Patel: Opening now. Do we have vector assets or only PNGs?

Maya Chen: They included an SVG zip and PNGs. Design spotted a spacing issue on the reversed (white) mark over purple. @DesignLead any notes?

DesignLead: The reversed mark sits too tight in the circular clearspace at 240x135 thumbnails. Recommend 8px extra horizontal padding for that thumbnail crop and remove inline fill attrs in the SVG so we can swap colors cleanly. This is a layout tweak, not resizing the mark.

Samir Rao: We should ask CloudAlpha for explicit permission to tweak SVG fills and to approve the padding as a layout change. Also confirm the Nimbus Retail quote release.

Kevin Patel: Their brand guidelines state "do not distort proportions" but allow color variants when approved. I'll call the padding a layout adjustment that keeps proportions intact.

Alice Gomez: Looping Legal. Changing SVG path fills is considered a logo modification and needs partner sign-off. Padding is fine as layout. Ask CloudAlpha for a one-line permission for the SVG edits and a short quote release line for Nimbus.

Maya Chen: Draft to Sarita for review please. We need response by EOD Fri to hit our Tues publish.

Samir Rao: Draft: "Hi Sarita\u2014 two quick asks to finalize our marketplace brief: 1) Approve a minor layout padding (8px) around the CloudAlpha mark in marketplace thumbnails (no change to logo proportions). 2) Permit Redwood to update SVG fill attributes so the mark can render white on dark backgrounds. 3) Confirm Nimbus Retail quote is approved for joint marketing use by Redwood and CloudAlpha. A simple reply approving the three items is sufficient. Planned publish: Tues. Thanks, Samir"

Alice Gomez: Add offer for a one-click signed consent if they'd rather.

Samir Rao: Sent. PartnershipsBot: Reminder: approvals older than 7 days require reconfirmation.

PartnershipsBot: Sarita (CloudAlpha) replied: "Approved all three asks. You may adjust padding and update svg fills. Quote release acknowledged."

Maya Chen: Great. Next steps: DesignLead make the tiny SVG edits and export 2x/3x thumbnails, Kevin upload to s3 path, Legal mark approval in tracker, I schedule publish.

DesignLead: Edited svgs, exported PNGs (240x135@2x, @3x and 480x270 for 2x), replaced thumbnail in the PDF, pushed to s3: s3://redwood-assets/marketplace/cloudalpha/.

Kevin Patel: Uploaded final exports and bumped the brief version to v3 on the files link.

Alice Gomez: Logged consent in Partner Tracker PR-2026-337. No further legal flags.

Maya Chen: Moving to publish queue. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
